claims.summary: Fresh v0.15.150 GPT-5.5-pro Python ZIP/log evidence exported at 99/A with Texture 91, export verification passed, and zero embedded P0/P1/P2 findings.
The same artifact contained hidden CS/Python source debt: Correlation was trusted for Python variables, so the stricter local grader regraded it at 98/A.
CS/Python source selection and grading now reject statistical-variable bycatch unless programming context is present.
CS/Python Course Map fallback repair now uses programming-specific code-tracing, debugging, testing, and runnable-artifact language instead of generic assigned-material scaffolds.
Focused regressions cover source-ledger promotion, deep quality regrade behavior, and Course Map fallback texture for the live GPT-5.5-pro failure shape.

knownRemainingTargets: A fresh deployed v0.15.151 GPT-5.5-pro Python ZIP/log audit must prove the source ledger no longer trusts statistical-variable bycatch in real provider output.
Texture remains below the long-running target until fresh packages repeatedly reach 100/100 texture with no repeated-shingle caveat.
The visible v0.15.150 run completed in 1487s and cost about $9.98, so model comparisons should include runtime and cost, not only score.

The v0.15.150 CourseIR direct-authoring call still fell back to native authoring after spending a large pro-model call; this release records that evidence but does not change CourseIR fallback behavior.
